...As you may have observed, I was assisting
a classmate with her training until just now.
—Before I realized it, the words had left my mouth.

If my actions allow her to continue running for longer in the future...
then that is a gratifying outcome in itself.

Maintaining a constant, steady condition under all circumstances...
That is unquestionably one of her extraordinary qualities.

Well then... if I may take advantage of your kind offer,
there is something I would like to ask of you—

...I think that's wonderful. But the time Ikuno Dictus
dedicates to helping her friend is anything but trivial.
I'm so glad—
Her drive is remarkable. She dives into academic texts that even professionals like us study, and pays careful attention to her daily diet and sleep—

If you're ever in trouble, Ikuno, I'll be the one helping you next time!!
See you tomorrowww!!

...She suffered an injury in the past,
which left her unable to run for a period of time.

I believe that this fulfillment will...
ultimately feed back into my own running as well.

The person who told me that was an instructor at Tracen Academy
who trains pre-debut Umamusume—
Yes, let us both give it our all.

There are plenty of serious Umamusume at the academy.
However, in her case, as I mentioned, her consistency is simply off the charts.
A few days after my first conversation with Ikuno Dictus—

Yet at the same time, for a student to hold such an outlook...
it felt remarkably altruistic—
Yes, of course.

The unwavering resolve in her eyes and the words she spoke that day.
They still lingered within me, carrying a quiet warmth—

Not at all. Everything was the result of your own hard work.
I merely provided a modest amount of assistance.

There is no issue. I have already finished adjusting my schedule
to account for the modified plans. Furthermore—

What kind of "goal" was she truly aiming for?
As my curiosity grew stronger with each passing day—

I merely assisted with management in a modest capacity
so that she could progress smoothly at her own pace.

Checking the upcoming mock race schedule,
Ikuno Dictus's name was nowhere to be found.

Haha, that's so like you, Ikuno. ...I'm definitely going to run
the next mock race all the way to the end! Good luck to you too, Ikuno!

Ikuno Dictus watched her running partner with a hint of joy in her eyes.
There was nothing unusual in the way she ran...

Seeing her so disheartened when she couldn't run properly despite her body healing...
I could not simply overlook it.

Her name, which had consistently appeared in every recent mock race,
had suddenly vanished from a certain point onward, sending a chill down my spine.

When it comes to high awareness regarding self-management,
there are very few Umamusume like her.

I spotted Ikuno Dictus interacting with another Umamusume.
No sooner had they exchanged a few words than the two took off running.
...There was something I wished to prioritize over mock races.
Yes...! Splendidly done...!

I see, so you were concerned for me.
However, please rest assured. As you can see, all parameters are normal.

...She is running mock races today as well.
With her unchanging, steadfast stability and strength.
As a Trainer, that was a sentiment I could deeply resonate with.

She utilizes her extraordinary self-management skills to help others—
I want her to be rewarded before anyone else. That feeling welled up within me.

—Haaaaah!!
...Alright, yes, yes, YES! I'm running!!

—Yeah, I feel like I'm ready now...!
Ikuno, could we do one final practice run together?

You are the Trainer from the other day—
...Thank you for your assistance back then.

Thank you so much, Ikuno...!
Thanks to you, I really think I can run in races now!!

Never late, never absent. Never misses a detail, asks proactive questions.
Always diligent with her training attitude and equipment maintenance—

To help her run again and ease the tension in her mind and body,
I formulated a training plan broken into many small steps—

To run more than anyone else and grow stronger through that experience... I consider that
the discipline required to achieve the 'goal' that only I can fulfill.

...If from your perspective she appeared to be enjoying her run,
then it seems my role was successfully fulfilled.

...Just by asking around the academy,
I heard nothing but praise for Ikuno Dictus's extraordinary management skills.

As far as I've seen, she has never experienced a slump.
I haven't ever sensed even the slightest hint of one.

She worked hard on rehabilitation and made a full recovery, but...
due to the long hiatus, she fell into an emotionally unstable state—
Haa... haa... haa...!

—If I were to describe Ikuno Dictus in a single phrase,
it would be 'flawless stability.'

—Ikuno Dictus-san has consulted me
regarding self-care on several occasions.
—One day, a 'change' occurred.

Dreading the worst-case scenarios, I ran all over the academy
searching for Ikuno Dictus, as if trying to outrun my own anxiety—
